title: Jashn-E-Mumbai’s Cultural Night
summary: Jashn-E-Mumbai’s Cultural Night, followed by the DG-DRR Dinner, brought together 600+ attendees, including over 40 Rotaractors from 13 domestic districts and 4 international…
description:
Jashn-E-Mumbai’s Cultural Night, followed by the DG-DRR Dinner, brought together 600+ attendees, including over 40 Rotaractors from 13 domestic districts and 4 international districts: Nepal, Tanzania, Kenya, and Mexico, reflecting strong regional and international participation.
The event was supported by Rotary Club of Bombay And Rotary Club of Mumbai Juhu

The evening commenced with Regal District Governor Rtn. Rajan Dua’s keynote address, providing leadership and direction to the gathering. The celebration then featured an energetic Bollywood jamming session by Divyaansh Raaj and his band, Jams and Vibes, followed by the Maha Aarti, which added a spiritual and traditional element to the evening. Team JOSH from RCSIES then delivered a vibrant cultural performance showcasing artistic talent.
The event was supported by Inkzoid, Mad Over Donuts, and Ink Wizard as sponsors, with TCET Capture serving as the Photography Partner.
